item.title: EU proposes 21st Russia sanctions package targeting a $120B crypto network and a potential ban on third-country crypto service firms.
MiCA EU-wide licensing deadline passed July 1 with fewer than 230 of 3,000+ registered crypto firms holding valid authorizations.
GENIUS Act marks one year in force as regulators finalize implementation rules for a $310B stablecoin market.
SEC advances three July rulemakings on crypto token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and trading venue standards.
Bridge protocols lose $35M across coordinated exploits in six hours: $24M drained from AFX Trade, $7.5M from the Verus ETH bridge.
BNY completes first after-hours stablecoin-reserve trade and plans 24/7 settlement rails for U.S. Treasuries and tokenized equivalents.
UK government forms tokenization taskforce with BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Morgan Stanley to pilot securities settlement.
Tokenization is now a strategic priority for 84% of financial institutions, with 44% of capital markets firms running live deployments.
UK FCA launches Qualifying Cryptoasset Trading Platform regime allowing overseas exchanges to serve UK clients via licensed branches.
Ostium protocol loses $18M after attacker submits oracle reports with future-dated timestamps to trigger fraudulent keeper payouts.
North Korea detains nationals accused of laundering money stolen from a state bank through cryptocurrency networks.
U.S. CLARITY Act Senate floor vote remains unscheduled; prediction markets lower odds of 2026 passage to 32%.
Ripple launches institutional RLUSD minting platform and adds the stablecoin to Notabene's Travel Rule compliance network.
BitMEX shuts down and faces a proposed class-action lawsuit alleging theft and insider trading.
